t: This is the Saatchi Gallery, a contemporary art gallery and independent charity in Chelsea, housed in the former Duke of York's headquarters. Charles Saatchi opened it in 1985, first in North London, then on the South Bank, and finally here. Its shows began with American artists and minimalism, then moved to the young British artists led by Damien Hirst, and later to painting. That helped it become a recognised authority on contemporary art. Saatchi also co-founded the advertising agency Saatchi and Saatchi with his brother Maurice.
